mean_square_obstruction.known_failure_mode: a sparse exceptional set can still contain all prime-square rows unless an object-sensitive endpoint theorem is added
mean_square_obstruction.missing_pointwise_gate: no exceptional prime-square phase for all P and all relevant fibers

pattern_count_localization_obstruction.reason: when theta>1/2, the outer tail length is comparable to the whole thick container, so pattern abundance need not intersect the first row
pattern_count_localization_obstruction.required_statement: there is a prime inside the initial/final length-P subinterval for every prime P
pattern_count_localization_obstruction.whole_container_statement: there are prime APs or many primes in a short interval of length X^theta

scale_audit.why_theta_gt_half_does_not_localize: for theta>1/2 the container (P^2,P^2+P^(2theta)] has an outer tail of length P^(2theta)-P, asymptotically almost the whole container
